entries.roblox_recipe: ImageLabel overlay tween, or particles streaking backward.

entries.name: Anime Impact Frame
entries.description: One-frame high-contrast inverted flash on a big hit.
entries.roblox_recipe: full-screen white/black Frame for 1-2 frames plus ColorCorrection.

entries.name: Muzzle Flash
entries.description: Short bright cone at the barrel.
entries.roblox_recipe: PointLight + particle emit 1 frame, Rotation random.

entries.name: Shield Bubble
entries.description: Translucent sphere with hex pattern that ripples on hit.
entries.roblox_recipe: Neon sphere, Fresnel-like transparency, scale pulse on damage.

entries.name: Blood Splat Stylised
entries.description: Colour-neutral splat (paint, slime) for family-friendly games.
entries.roblox_recipe: decal burst, no gore.

entries.name: Magic Circle Cast
entries.description: Rotating rune circle on the ground while casting.
entries.roblox_recipe: Decal/SurfaceGui image, tween Rotation, fade out.

entries.name: Heal Aura
entries.description: Rising green sparkles and soft glow.
entries.roblox_recipe: ParticleEmitter upward Speed, LightEmission 0.5.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries.description: Jagged beam flickering between points.
entries.roblox_recipe: Beam with random mid attachments, rebuild each 0.05s.

entries.name: Ice Shatter
entries.description: Crystals burst outward with cold mist.
entries.roblox_recipe: shard parts with velocity + particle mist.

entries.name: Water Splash
entries.description: Droplets and ring on contact.
entries.roblox_recipe: emit droplets with gravity (Acceleration), ripple ring.

entries.name: Fireball Explosion
entries.description: Fire core, smoke and debris.
entries.roblox_recipe: layered emitters (flash, fire, smoke), Explosion with no damage for push.

entries.name: Black Hole Vortex
entries.description: Swirling particles pulled to centre.
entries.roblox_recipe: emitter with negative Acceleration toward centre + rotating mesh.

entries.name: Meteor Impact
entries.description: Fire trail, impact flash, crater dust.
entries.roblox_recipe: Trail + particle burst + camera shake.

entries.name: Teleport Portal
entries.description: Ring with swirling inner and flash on entry.
entries.roblox_recipe: Rotating mesh, particle swirl, light.

entries.name: Poison Cloud
entries.description: Low green fog with bubbles.
entries.roblox_recipe: slow big particles, Transparency 0.6.

entries.name: Rain and Snow
entries.description: Weather particles following the camera.
entries.roblox_recipe: emitter in a part above the camera, or collision-aware rain.

entries.name: Dust Footsteps
entries.description: Small puffs at feet when running or landing.
entries.roblox_recipe: emit 3-5 on Running state or animation markers.

entries.name: Smoke Puff
entries.description: Soft rising smoke.
entries.roblox_recipe: texture sheet, Size grows, Transparency to 1.

entries.name: Torch Fire
entries.description: Looping flame with embers and flicker light.
entries.roblox_recipe: Fire emitter + PointLight Brightness noise.

entries.name: God Rays Light Shafts
entries.description: Beams from a window or sky.
entries.roblox_recipe: SunRaysEffect or stretched neon planes at low alpha.

entries.name: Fireflies Ambient
entries.description: Glowing motes drifting in dusk scenes.
entries.roblox_recipe: low-rate emitters with random Rotation and fading glow.

entries.name: Rocket Smoke Trail
entries.description: Smoke line behind projectiles.
entries.roblox_recipe: Trail plus smoke emitter attached to the rocket.

entries.name: Level-Up Burst
entries.description: Gold burst, rays and banner.
entries.roblox_recipe: UI ImageLabel scale + 2D particle spritesheet.

entries.name: Coin Gem Sparkle
entries.description: Sparkles on pickup that fly to the HUD counter.
entries.roblox_recipe: tween clones toward the currency icon, then count up.

entries.name: Rarity Glow Beam
entries.description: Coloured light pillar by rarity when a drop spawns.
entries.roblox_recipe: tall Neon part + Beam, colour from rarity table.

entries.name: Confetti Celebration
entries.description: Multi-colour falling pieces.
entries.roblox_recipe: emitter with ColorSequence random keypoints, gravity.

entries.name: Damage Number Pop
entries.description: Numbers arc up with scale punch.
entries.roblox_recipe: pooled BillboardGui, tween.

entries.name: Screen Damage Vignette
entries.description: Red edges pulse at low health.
entries.roblox_recipe: full-screen gradient frame with transparency tween.

entries.name: Glitch Chromatic Pulse
entries.description: RGB split and jitter for hacks or hits.
entries.roblox_recipe: ColorCorrection/Blur tween + offset duplicate frames.

entries.name: Powerup Aura Flames
entries.description: Body-wrapped flame aura for boosted states.
entries.roblox_recipe: emitters on limbs, LightEmission 1.

entries.name: Spawn Dissolve
entries.description: Materialize or dissolve with edge glow.
entries.roblox_recipe: tween part Transparency + particles at edges.

entries.name: Particle Texture Library
entries.description: Texture sheets for ParticleEmitters (sparks, smoke, rings, beams).
entries.roblox_recipe: use greyscale/white PNGs and tint with ColorSequence.

entries.name: Cartoon VFX Spritesheets
entries.description: Stylised cartoon burst, smoke and impact sheets.
entries.roblox_recipe: flipbook via ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout.

entries.name: Button Click
entries.description: Short, dry, mid-high click (30-120 ms) that confirms a press. Keep it quiet and consistent: players hear it hundreds of times.
entries.roblox_recipe: Sound in a UI SoundGroup at Volume 0.3-0.5, play with SoundService:PlayLocalSound so it does not replicate; vary PlaybackSpeed 0.97-1.03 only.

entries.name: Button Hover Tick
entries.description: Very soft tick (10-40 ms), lower volume than click. Use sparingly on desktop only.
entries.roblox_recipe: trigger from MouseEnter, throttle to once per 80 ms, skip on touch.

entries.name: Menu Open Whoosh
entries.description: Soft rising whoosh (150-300 ms) on panel open, mirrored falling version on close.
entries.roblox_recipe: pair with the pop-in tween so sound peak lands when the scale overshoots.

entries.name: Confirm Success Chime
entries.description: Bright two-note rising chime (200-400 ms).
entries.roblox_recipe: for purchases and claims, play after server confirmation, not on click.

entries.name: Error Buzz
entries.description: Low short buzz or dull thud (100-250 ms), never harsh.
entries.roblox_recipe: pair with the UI error shake.

entries.name: Toggle Switch
entries.description: Two distinct pitches for on and off (slight pitch up for on).
entries.roblox_recipe: one Sound, set PlaybackSpeed 1.1 or 0.9.

entries.name: Notification Ping
entries.description: Gentle bell or pluck, 300-600 ms, rate-limited.
entries.roblox_recipe: cap to one ping per second; group ducking not needed.

entries.name: Purchase Cha-Ching
entries.description: Coin and register sparkle (400-800 ms) for purchases.
entries.roblox_recipe: play locally on server-confirmed purchase.

entries.name: Coin Pickup Pitch Ladder
entries.description: Coin tick whose pitch rises on consecutive pickups, resetting after a pause.
entries.roblox_recipe: PlaybackSpeed = 1 + 0.05*combo capped at 1.6.

entries.name: Level-Up Fanfare
entries.description: Short ascending brass or synth stinger (1-2 s) with a sparkle tail.
entries.roblox_recipe: duck music via SoundGroup volume tween while it plays.

entries.name: Reward Chest Open
entries.description: Creak or latch, burst, then sparkle shimmer layered over 1-2 s.
entries.roblox_recipe: three Sounds timed to the chest animation markers.

entries.name: Countdown Beep
entries.description: Three identical beeps and a higher final beep.
entries.roblox_recipe: PlaybackSpeed 1.0 for 3-2-1, 1.5 for GO.

entries.name: Typewriter Text Blip
entries.description: Tiny blip per character, pitch-randomised slightly, per speaker voice.
entries.roblox_recipe: play every 2nd character, skip spaces.

entries.name: Sword Swing Whoosh
entries.description: Fast airy whoosh (150-300 ms), several variants rotated.
entries.roblox_recipe: start the sound on the animation marker, 3-5 variants, PlaybackSpeed jitter 0.92-1.08.

entries.name: Sword Hit Metal
entries.description: Metallic clang with short ring (200-500 ms).
entries.roblox_recipe: layer a low thud under the clang; play at the hit position.

entries.name: Punch Impact
entries.description: Meaty low thump plus short noise slap (100-250 ms).
entries.roblox_recipe: 4+ variants, louder for crits, 3D rolloff with RollOffMaxDistance about 60.

entries.name: Heavy Slam
entries.description: Deep boom with sub tail (500-1000 ms) and debris rattle.
entries.roblox_recipe: low-pass via EqualizerSoundEffect for distant players.

entries.name: Block Parry Clang
entries.description: Sharp metallic ping, brighter than a normal hit so the parry reads clearly.
entries.roblox_recipe: distinct pitch band from hit sounds.

entries.name: Projectile Whoosh
entries.description: Passing whoosh with Doppler feel.
entries.roblox_recipe: 3D sound parented to the projectile, RollOffMode InverseTapered.

entries.name: Gunshot
entries.description: Transient crack plus tail.
entries.roblox_recipe: short tail for close, longer reverb for outdoors; compress to avoid clipping.

entries.name: Reload Click
entries.description: Mechanical clicks in sequence synced to animation.
entries.roblox_recipe: one Sound per marker (mag out, mag in, bolt).

entries.name: Explosion
entries.description: Initial crack, low boom, long rumble tail (1-3 s).
entries.roblox_recipe: distance-based low-pass and delay for far players.

entries.name: Shield Break
entries.description: Glassy shatter plus low thud.
entries.roblox_recipe: layer chimes at high pitch.

entries.name: Critical Hit Sting
entries.description: Short bright sting above the normal hit.
entries.roblox_recipe: tie to the crit damage-number pop.

entries.name: Hurt Grunt
entries.description: Short voice grunt, several variants, rate-limited so low health spam is not annoying.
entries.roblox_recipe: cooldown 0.5 s per player.

entries.name: Death Sound
entries.description: Distinct non-annoying stinger.
entries.roblox_recipe: global low-pass dip for 0.5 s on local player death.

entries.name: Spell Cast Charge
entries.description: Rising shimmer that builds to the release.
entries.roblox_recipe: tween PlaybackSpeed 0.8 to 1.3 over the charge time.

entries.name: Magic Impact
entries.description: Boom with sparkle shatter.
entries.roblox_recipe: reverb on SFX group, brighter EQ for ice, darker for dark magic.

entries.name: Heal Chime
entries.description: Warm ascending arpeggio, soft attack.
entries.roblox_recipe: low volume, no sharp transient.

entries.name: Lightning Zap
entries.description: Crackle burst with sub thump.
entries.roblox_recipe: add DistortionSoundEffect lightly for edge.

entries.name: Fire Whoosh
entries.description: Noise whoosh with low roar.
entries.roblox_recipe: loop a crackle bed for burning objects (3D, Looped).

entries.name: Ice Crackle
entries.description: High glassy crackle with short tinkles.
entries.roblox_recipe: EQ boost around 6-8 kHz.

entries.name: Laser Beam
entries.description: Sustained hum plus onset zap.
entries.roblox_recipe: Looped Sound with PlaybackSpeed modulated by charge.

entries.name: Teleport Whoosh
entries.description: Reversed whoosh into a tight pop.
entries.roblox_recipe: sync pop with the portal flash VFX.

entries.name: Power-Up Jingle
entries.description: Quick rising arpeggio with sparkle.
entries.roblox_recipe: short (500 ms) to avoid blocking gameplay.

entries.name: Shield Hum
entries.description: Low sustained hum with slight tremolo.
entries.roblox_recipe: Looped, volume tween on activate.

entries.name: Footsteps by Surface
entries.description: Short steps with 4-6 variants per material, triggered by animation markers and Humanoid.FloorMaterial.
entries.roblox_recipe: map Enum.Material to a SoundGroup of variants; random pick avoiding repeat.

entries.name: Jump and Land
entries.description: Soft cloth or gear rustle on jump, thump on land scaled by fall speed.
entries.roblox_recipe: Humanoid.StateChanged Jumping and Landed.

entries.name: Swim Splash
entries.description: Splash on entry, soft bubbling loop underwater with low-pass.
entries.roblox_recipe: EqualizerSoundEffect on the local group when camera is underwater.

entries.name: Door and Mechanism
entries.description: Creak, latch, slide with positional rolloff.
entries.roblox_recipe: 3D sounds on the model, play on open/close tween.

entries.name: Wind Ambience Loop
entries.description: Low wind bed, volume modulated slowly.
entries.roblox_recipe: Looped Sound in an Ambient group, tween volume with noise.

entries.name: Rain Ambience Loop
entries.description: Steady rain bed, crossfade indoors.
entries.roblox_recipe: reduce volume and low-pass when roofed (raycast up).

entries.name: Forest Ambience
entries.description: Birds and rustle layered over wind.
entries.roblox_recipe: layer 3 loops with different lengths so it never repeats audibly.

entries.name: Cave Reverb
entries.description: Long reverb on footsteps and voices inside caves.
entries.roblox_recipe: ReverbSoundEffect on an area SoundGroup, enable on zone enter.

entries.name: Fire Crackle Loop
entries.description: Positional crackle for torches and campfires.
entries.roblox_recipe: 3D Looped, RollOffMaxDistance 40.

entries.name: Vehicle Engine Loop
entries.description: Looped engine whose PlaybackSpeed follows speed.
entries.roblox_recipe: map velocity to PlaybackSpeed 0.8-2.0.

entries.name: Crowd and Pet Cute Sounds
entries.description: Short chirps and squeaks for pets, randomised pitch per pet.
entries.roblox_recipe: per-pet pitch seed.

entries.name: Lobby Music Loop
entries.description: Seamless loop 60-120 s with no abrupt ending.
entries.roblox_recipe: Looped Sound in a Music group, fade between tracks over 1-2 s.

entries.name: Adaptive Combat Layers
entries.description: Add or remove stems (drums, bass, lead) by intensity.
entries.roblox_recipe: several synced Sounds, tween volumes by tension value.

entries.name: Boss Intro Stinger
entries.description: Big hit plus riser (2-4 s) timed to the boss reveal.
entries.roblox_recipe: duck all other groups while it plays.

entries.name: Round Start End Stingers
entries.description: Short fanfares for start and win/lose.
entries.roblox_recipe: differentiate win (major) and lose (minor).

entries.name: Horror Drone
entries.description: Low evolving drone, filtered noise, occasional sub pulses.
entries.roblox_recipe: Looped, slow volume swell, low-pass EQ.

entries.name: Jumpscare Sting
entries.description: Loud short sting with a quiet lead-in for contrast.
entries.roblox_recipe: compress heavily, play once; accessibility option to reduce.

entries.name: Heartbeat Low Health
entries.description: Looped heartbeat that speeds up as health falls.
entries.roblox_recipe: PlaybackSpeed 1 to 1.6, plus low-pass on other sounds.

entries.name: Button hover scale + press squash
entries.description: Grows a button on hover and squashes on press using UIScale, so layout is unaffected.

entries.name: Pop-in panel open/close
entries.description: Panel scales from 0.8 to 1 with a Back overshoot while fading in via a CanvasGroup.

entries.name: Currency count-up
entries.description: Rolls a number to a new value by tweening a NumberValue (TweenService cannot tween text directly).

entries.name: Shine sweep across a button
entries.description: A diagonal white highlight sweeps across a button using a UIGradient transparency ramp and an Offset tween.

entries.name: Error shake
entries.description: Short horizontal shake for invalid input or a failed purchase.

entries.name: Responsive scale + safe area
entries.description: Scales a fixed-design ScreenGui to any viewport with UIScale and respects device safe insets.

entries.name: Pooled toast notifications
entries.description: Stacks up to N toasts with slide-in/out, auto-dismiss and a UIListLayout.

entries.name: Hit spark burst
entries.description: One-shot spark burst at an impact point using ParticleEmitter:Emit and a short Lifetime.

entries.name: Shockwave ring
entries.description: Expanding flat ring for landings and heavy hits, built from a Neon cylinder and a tween.

entries.name: Lightning bolt with Beams
entries.description: Jagged beam between two points rebuilt a few times so it flickers.

entries.name: Weapon swing Trail
entries.description: Adds a Trail between two attachments on a blade and toggles it during swings.

entries.name: Confetti burst
entries.description: Multi-colour falling confetti using random ColorSequence keypoints and gravity.

entries.name: Tween a ParticleEmitter NumberSequence
entries.description: TweenService cannot tween NumberSequence properties, so drive them from a NumberValue.

entries.name: Scriptable camera cutscene
entries.description: Plays a list of camera shots by tweening Camera.CFrame between marker parts, then restores control.

entries.name: Letterbox bars
entries.description: Two black bars slide in for cinematic mode and out afterwards.

entries.name: Simple camera shake
entries.description: Decaying random camera offset applied each frame on top of the default camera.

entries.name: Sprint FOV kick
entries.description: Widens field of view while sprinting and eases back.

entries.description: Creates Music / SFX / UI groups, applies a shared Reverb once and exposes volume sliders.
